_meta.description: Four geographically separated lunar sites with sourced coordinates. Elevation is sampled from global NASA LOLA LDEM_4; slope from global LDSM_16; illumination is an explicit ideal-horizon gameplay model; bulk hydrogen has a published global Lunar Prospector-derived map but site estimates have not yet been sampled.
_meta.freeze_scope: Site identities, coordinates, NASA LOLA elevation/slope samples, and field provenance are frozen for this build snapshot. Illumination remains a disclosed ideal-horizon model. A global Lunar Prospector-derived hydrogen map is now recorded as a source, but no coordinate estimate is assigned until its archived grid is sampled with footprint and uncertainty metadata. When source data changes, create a new dataset revision and preserve prior snapshots in version control.
_meta.how_to_fill: Refresh NASA LOLA elevation/slope when newer or finer global products are selected. For illumination, record a NASA layer, period, coordinate, and sampling method or replace the disclosed geometric model. For bulk hydrogen, sample the published global Lunar Prospector map at a declared footprint and retain its spatial scale and systematic uncertainty; do not substitute a broad regional range for a site sample.

sites.name: Tranquility Base (Apollo 11)
sites.description: Historic Apollo 11 landing location in Mare Tranquillitatis. Global LOLA terrain values are sampled at the documented coordinate; illumination is modeled and a global hydrogen product is identified but has not yet been sampled at this site.

coordinates.source: NASA NSSDC Apollo landing site coordinates, Apollo 11 / Mare Tranquillitatis; 0.67416°N, 23.47314°E. https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/lunar_sites.html

illumination_pct.source: Geometric model assumption: 50% sun visibility averaged over a full lunar day at non-polar latitude, with a level horizon. This is not a sampled NASA illumination raster and excludes local terrain horizons; use as a gameplay baseline only.

elevation_m.source: NASA PDS LRO LOLA GDR v1.0 LDEM_4 (global, 4 pixels/degree; 7.58084 km/pixel), sampled from the pixel containing this coordinate. DN × 0.5 m; height relative to the 1,737.4 km reference sphere, not geoid-corrected elevation. https://pds.nasa.gov/ds-view/pds/viewProfile.jsp?dsid=LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
elevation_m.sample_method: Nearest containing pixel; zero-based row/column [357, 93]; pixel center lat/lon [0.625, 23.375] degrees

slope_deg.source: NASA PDS LRO LOLA GDR v1.0 LDSM_16 (product v2.0), global slope map at 16 pixels/degree (1.89521 km/pixel; 240 m slope baseline), sampled from the pixel containing this coordinate. Slope = DN × 0.0015 + 45 degrees. https://pds.nasa.gov/ds-view/pds/viewProfile.jsp?dsid=LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
slope_deg.sample_method: Containing pixel; zero-based row/column [1429, 375]; pixel center lat/lon [0.65625, 23.46875] degrees

hydrogen_ppm.availability_note: Current global estimate not sampled; legacy comparison is archived separately
hydrogen_ppm.source: No current site estimate assigned yet. The 2022 global Lunar Prospector neutron-derived map has not been sampled at this coordinate. A legacy 2001 NASA PDS grid sample is preserved in Resources/source_data/lunar_prospector_legacy_samples.json for comparison only; its limitations prevent use as the current site value. The cited polar-only LEND result is not applicable. No point value is inferred.
